messages:
alex: Heads up — PR #4821 (kv-cache refactor) landed this morning and nightly long-seq benchmark shows a regression. p50 +12ms, p95 +70ms, throughput ~8% down. Link: https://ci.redwood/bench/4821
ci-bot: [nightly-bench] run 2026-01-30T07:03Z — model=long-seq, steps=1024, runs=50 — p50: 128ms -> 140ms (+12ms), p95: 210ms -> 280ms (+70ms), mem RSS peak 6.2GB -> 7.8GB (+1.6GB) — details: https://ci.redwood/bench/4821/details
maria: ack. do we have the flamegraph/artifacts?
alex: uploaded flamegraph + diffs: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/4821/flame.svg and https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821/files
ryan: looking now. quick scan — the refactor removed the shallow copy on the KV shard map? that could explain mem +1.6GB. can you paste the exact diff that changed cache ownership?
alex: snippet from PR:```
- shard_map = deepcopy(cache.shards)
+ shard_map = cache.shards
```
(along with some iterator changes in kv_store.py)
maria: if shards are mutable and used across requests without copy that might grow KV lifetime. also the iterator change touches chunked eviction logic. worth checking eviction loop for retention of references.
sarah: is this blocking the release? we're in soft freeze for the week but not strict. if it's a perf regression we should either patch or revert ASAP.
ryan: I'll take it. repro locally with bench script:```
./tools/bench.sh --model long-seq --seq-len 8192 --runs 30 --ci-mode
```
I can reproduce p50 +10–15ms. grabbing heap/profile now.
ci-bot: artifact upload in progress: /tmp/ci/4821/heap-profile.pprof
alex: thanks. if it's a small lifetime bug please add a unit or perf test. would prefer targeted fix instead of revert.
maria: agree on test. also add a short perf regression check in PR that runs the long-seq baseline (even if cheap).
ryan: initial root cause: iterator kept a reference when we switched to view-based iteration; fix is to use .copy() in the eviction path and avoid global view holding. patching now.
alex: ping @ryan for review + approval once you open the fix PR. we need a green bench run before merging.
ryan: opened PR 4828 with fix + perf test. bench run queued: https://ci.redwood/bench/4828
ci-bot: [bench] queued, will post results when complete.
sarah: thanks all. keep me posted — if bench doesn't drop back to baseline within 2 runs we should revert 4821.
ryan: first bench: p50 back to 129ms, p95 212ms, mem peak 6.3GB. second run identical. marking as approval ready.
alex: great — leaving final merge approval to @maria for test coverage + ops notes.
maria: LGTM for fixes and test. adding approval now. :thumbsup:
ryan: merging in 5m. will follow up with release note entry.
alex: thanks everyone. closing thread.
